_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 47: 3-8 January 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to believe that in 2026 whatever they were in debt they will have as liquid in the bank, so that if they owe a hundred thousand on something they will have that hundred thousand in the bank as surplus, after taxes.
mentions.quote: whatever you were in debt, you'll have liquid in the bank
mentions.falsify_match: Listeners reporting debts matched by savings within the year.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Unusually concrete for a prosperity declaration: it names a ratio.

mentions.claim_text: He says people gave their lives for the blessing they are about to partake in, that it was very serious, that many did not make it and suffered and died for the cause, referring to the Iraqi people having stood, and notes the taxes were brought up again today.
mentions.quote: Many people did not make it. And they suffered and they died
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: background to the currency and taxes material rather than a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He tells those who sowed sacrificially not to let go of it, and reports the Lord saying he is bringing forth great joy and a great harvest, days of heaven on earth, and that fun days are coming for his body.
mentions.quote: days of heaven on earth, fun days are coming for my body
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no measure of joy or of a day of heaven on earth.

mentions.claim_text: He raises the objection that if within a year people are not decamillionaires then it was a fault, a misword, and rejects it, saying instead that God prepares the heart, speaks something that got inside them on September 30th 2024, and that they keep believing and keep praying over it.
mentions.quote: then well, that was a fault a misword. No
mentions.falsify_match: The decamillionaire word had a stated year and the year has passed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He raises the miss himself and refuses it, which is the exact opposite of the Australia off-word offer five days later. Both are now on file.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for an expiration date on her being unable to talk, and says there are many people out there with a Megan in their household who do not talk and are not potty trained.
mentions.quote: an expiration date to her being unable to talk
mentions.falsify_match: His daughter speaking.
mentions.falsify_miss: She does not. He has been praying this for years and says so elsewhere, which is why it belongs on the record.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over marriages, saying they may be on their way to get a divorce right now or tomorrow, and that God brings back that love again so the husband is not being mean and the wife is not mean.
mentions.quote: they may be on their way to get a divorce right now
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: any large audience supplies both outcomes.

mentions.claim_text: He says March is highlighted before him, that March is big, asks what it is about, and works through green and dangling and leaning to arrive at Greenland, praying in tongues between the words.
mentions.quote: March is highlighted before me. I see March. March is big
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland event in March 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet March. Worth noting he reaches Greenland by working outward from the word green rather than being given it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether it is stubborn, says that is what he sees, prays in tongues, repeats that he sees March and is praying about the month of March, that it is cold, and begins to describe a dividing.
mentions.quote: I see March. praying about the month of March, and it's cold
mentions.falsify_match: A division or split connected to Greenland in March.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. Cold in March in Greenland is not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says they may already have this, that this is what he sees, and that he does not know why but it is like restaurants, like a stimulation of life.
mentions.quote: I don't know why, but it's like restaurants. Like a stimulation of life
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: he states he does not know what the image means.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will hear about it a lot in the days ahead, that he sees 2027 highlighted, that he does not really see anything about the other year, and that 2027 is highlighted big concerning this.
mentions.quote: I see 2027 highlighted. 2027 is highlighted big
mentions.falsify_match: Something significant in 2027 on this subject.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. What this is remains unstated in the passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says they really need to pray for the elections and for the wealth transfer, and that he sees a major blip concerning November of this year.
mentions.quote: this is a major major blip here concerning November of this year
mentions.falsify_match: A significant disruption around the November midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2026 will be a year of a lot of political theatre escalating clear up until the summer, that they will hear impeach repeated in the days ahead and it will be said a lot, and that they will try to remove him.
mentions.quote: you would hear in the days ahead impeach impeach impeach
mentions.falsify_match: Impeachment attempts through the first half of 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says to pray for the nation and the president because he has a lot of hard decisions to make, that they still have to pray over the elections coming up in 2026, and that the country will look a lot different by then, noting it is 250 years.
mentions.quote: the country will look a lot different by then
mentions.falsify_match: Visible national change by November.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Look a lot different has no threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is lighter on this side, that 2026 will mark a year like they have never seen before and that 2026, 2027 and 2028 will be an acceleration of things, then says the Lord told him to tell them again about the rat and names Elon.
mentions.quote: Tell him again about the rat
mentions.falsify_match: A betrayal or infiltration connected to the man named.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The rat is never explained in this passage, only repeated.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a lot more to this, that they will try to deny it, and repeats mate several times before landing on the mayors.
mentions.quote: they will try to deny that. The mayors
mentions.falsify_match: Mayors implicated in something they deny.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He arrives at the word by sounding it out, which is how several of these images are reached.

mentions.claim_text: He says that if they could get all that back they would not be in so much national debt, that they are trying to take down a beautiful nation, and that all these people deserve prison for treason.
mentions.quote: All these people deserve prison. treason against
mentions.falsify_match: Treason prosecutions.

mentions.claim_text: He says most of them do not have a clue how close he is to coming, that people say fifty years or a hundred or thirty, and that although no man knows the day or the hour they know the signs.
mentions.quote: most of you don't have a clue of how close he is to coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: closer than you think, with the no man knows clause attached.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God that they will have the greatest voter turnout even in November, and begins to compare it to how they had been praying for someone previously.
mentions.quote: we'll have the greatest turnout, voter turnout, even in November
mentions.falsify_match: Record midterm turnout in 2026, which is measurable.

mentions.claim_text: He says God knows how much he needs and he does not need brother or sister so and so to meet that need, that either God does it or he is not God, and that a ministry of hints is not God, mocking the appeal for help with bills.
mentions.quote: ministry of hints is not God
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a fundraising posture worth recording alongside the giving appeals elsewhere in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying to call in their unsaved loved ones because they are not too far gone, to bring them boldly daily before the throne and watch what he does, and that all in the year of 2026 they will see the manifestations concerning their unsaved loved ones if they call out.
mentions.quote: in 2026, you will see the manifestations concerning your unsaved loved ones
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on calling them out daily
mentions.falsify_match: Reported conversions among listeners' families in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the condition means an unanswered prayer is read as insufficient calling out.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying there is a shaking to awaken because his son's return is at hand, woe unto the land, and that the shaking to awaken will be all over South America, and that he is preparing the land for the harvest.
mentions.quote: a shaking to awaken and it will be all over South America
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval across South America followed by revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Shaking remains undefined, and here he says the current news is already it.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of souls saved for a major harvest and of a liberation, a liberation day, and says this is coming for Cuba too, that a liberation day is coming for Cuba, that it is on the hill, naming 2027 as a liberation day and a lot of liberation.
mentions.quote: a liberation day is coming for Cuba. 2027 liberation day
mentions.falsify_match: Regime change or major liberalisation in Cuba during 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens. A named country and a named year, which makes it one of the more checkable claims here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is looking into Canada and can see it clearly, that these are low level devils, that there are ranks of demonic forces, and begins to describe what is interfering there.
mentions.quote: these are low-level devils. There's ranks of demonic forces
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a ranking of unobservable actors.

mentions.claim_text: He says he heard impeach repeated again and a lot of uprising, that people were upset in 2026 clear up into it as a great distraction for the midterms, and that the Lord said they must vote and must pray now for the midterms.
mentions.quote: trying to be a great distraction for midterms
mentions.falsify_match: Impeachment proceedings and unrest through 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Distraction is the same frame as stay-vertical-2026-media-distraction.

mentions.claim_text: He says a grudge gives control over your life because love takes no account of a suffered wrong, and leads them to forgive an ex-wife or ex-husband, answering the objections that he beat me, he was verbally abusive, she cheated on me.
mentions.quote: love takes no account of or suffered wrong
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is more than one, that the Lord does not want them to take this into 2026, that they have been hurt for a long time and keep stuffing it down, and that they are passing it on to their children.
mentions.quote: the Lord wants you don't take this into your 2026
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says a five year old could do it, that if they said that prayer they are born again, and tells them to find a Bible believing church that teaches the word, recommending a non-denominational one because that is where they go.
mentions.quote: find a bible believing church that would teach you the word
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth noting he sends new converts to a local church rather than keeping them on the channel.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was moving so quickly that he wonders how it is even being shown to them, apologises for being tired and cranky, and begins to describe all the people.
mentions.quote: it was moving so quick, how are you even showing them that?
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an aside about the pace of what he is receiving.

mentions.claim_text: He says to remember what was said about three years, that 2026, 2027 and 2028 will be an acceleration of things that keeps accelerating toward the next cycle, and that it is a great opportunity for the Lord Jesus Christ.
mentions.quote: 3 years. 2026, 2027, 2028 will be an acceleration of things
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: acceleration with no measure, the 2023 word again.
